categories.main_business_segments: SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS operates two main business segments: EC Solutions and IT Solutions. The EC Solutions segment provides EC site construction packages (notably 'ecbeing'), customization, hosting, and value-added web marketing services. The IT Solutions segment offers proprietary software products (such as X-point Cloud, AgileWorks, and L2Blocker), network construction, IT equipment sales, and packaged software for corporate clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary software development for EC platforms, workflow systems, and security solutions. Key products are 'ecbeing' (EC site construction), 'X-point Cloud' and 'AgileWorks' (workflow systems), and 'L2Blocker' (unauthorized device detection and blocking). Production methods emphasize in-house software development, customization, and SaaS/cloud-based service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are mid-sized and large enterprises, especially internal departments seeking IT and EC solutions. The company serves a broad range of industries requiring EC platforms, workflow automation, and IT infrastructure, with a focus on the Japanese corporate sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Japan, with all major subsidiaries and business activities located domestically. There is no significant overseas revenue or asset base, and all sales are to Japanese customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS operates downstream in the supply chain, providing end-to-end IT and EC solutions directly to business clients. The company acts as a systems integrator, software vendor, and service provider, delivering finished solutions and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the EC Solutions business, strengthening cloud and security offerings, and enhancing product functionality to maintain market leadership. R&D focuses on improving core software products, developing new SaaS features, and leveraging AI (e.g., SafeAIGateway) to address evolving customer needs and market trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of software product sales, customization fees, SaaS/cloud service subscriptions, hosting, IT equipment sales, and value-added services. The EC Solutions segment emphasizes recurring revenue from SaaS and hosting, while IT Solutions includes both product and service-based income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In EC site construction, the company holds the No.1 domestic market share with 'ecbeing' and faces competition from several other software vendors, though it currently perceives no direct threat to its leading position. In IT solutions, it competes with other Japanese system integrators and software providers, differentiating itself through proprietary products and integrated service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 30.95 billion yen (up 10.9% YoY), with operating profit of 5.50 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.55 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue and profit over recent years, with a workforce of 1,101 employees and a strong balance sheet.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS emphasizes comprehensive, customizable, and secure IT/EC solutions tailored to enterprise needs. Its unique value lies in proprietary, market-leading products (especially 'ecbeing'), robust cloud and security offerings, and a full-service approach that positions the company as a 'best partner' rather than just a vendor. Continuous product enhancement and customer-centric innovation underpin its competitive differentiation.
